scope: The alert dialog's differences from the dialog (role=alertdialog, always modal, no outside-press dismissal, focus on the least destructive action) in happy-dom for the web component and the React renderer (server markup, client behavior); the shared dialog behavior is covered by the dialog's record. Rendered lengths are covered by the browser geometry check and the React parity check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: role=alertdialog and aria-modal, recipe classes, modal whatever the modal attribute, focus on the close part, outside press ignored, Escape and close-press reasons, focus returned, no native form elements
React SSR: the same data-* as the web component, role alertdialog, composed parts = preset; client: focus on Close, outside press ignored, Escape reason

limitations: The top layer, transitions and real focus movement need a real browser; the dialog's record lists what the unit tests cover.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html opens each pair of alert dialogs in turn and compares the popups part by part ("fails": []).

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-02, studio on the Components page Overlays family at u = 3, the theme unit 4.5 and 6, light and dark): growth (a long description wraps and the popup grows, then scrolls past the viewport less 8u; actions wrap at the end edge), RTL (dir=rtl: the actions sit at the inline end, text at the start), focus (focus opens on Cancel; rings are outlines and change no dimension), screenshots of the alert dialog open checked light and dark.
